reasons.missing_prices: The OSRS Wiki doesn't have both a buy and a sell price for it right now.
reasons.low_volume: Almost nobody traded it in the last day, so an offer might never fill.
reasons.short_history: There aren't enough recent trades to work out good prices for it.
reasons.stale_prices: Its latest prices aren't recent enough to trust right now.
reasons.no_profit_after_tax: The gap between its buy and sell prices is too small to make money after tax.
reasons.small_profit: Buying as many as recent trades can fill would make under 8,000 GP after tax.
reasons.wide_spread: Its buy and sell prices are too far apart to trust.
reasons.zero_quantity: Not enough has traded near these prices lately to suggest buying any.
reasons.too_expensive: One costs more than 3M GP, the most the Market suggests putting into one item.
reasons.price_spike: Its price just jumped, and too few sales at the new price back it up yet.
reasons.thin_margin: Each item makes so little profit that a tiny price drop would wipe it out.
reasons.thin_exit: Few players have bought it at the sell price lately, so it might not sell.

reasonFallback: It isn't one of today's suggestions. The Market's checks on price, trading and the 2% tax don't support a flip right now.
sharedLimitNotices: No automatic pick has room right now. Other Trader players have already planned as much of one item as the market can take. Room opens again at {time}. You can choose items yourself until then.
No automatic pick has room right now. Other Trader players have already planned as much of 3 items as the market can take. Room opens again at {time}. You can choose items yourself until then.

pump.title: You may be buying at the top
pump.body: Jumps like this often fall back. In past jumps, about half dropped by more than a tenth within a week. Waiting a week got a lower price more than half the time. About 1 in 4 kept rising, so it's your call.
rises: It's up about 15% on the week before, after jumping on far more trades than usual.
It's up about 40% on the week before, after jumping on far more trades than usual.
It's up about 125% on the week before, after jumping on far more trades than usual.

makeSell.heading: Make and Sell has room
makeSell.summary: Trader's picks are full right now.
makeSell.explainer: You can still use your GP. Buy on the GE, change it in the game, then sell.
makeSell.planned: Planned at today's prices, after tax
makeSell.empty: Room opens again at {time}. You can still pick any swap yourself in Make and Sell.
